dedupe_keys.name: 防災倉庫一覧 fire police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 防災倉庫一覧 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 船橋市. 市内の防災倉庫の一覧（避難所の防災倉庫を除く）. Coverage: 船橋市. The portal files it under the publisher 船橋市. Its tags are 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-08-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
